title: Visual Functions Affecting Vision-Related Quality of Life Following Intravitreal Ranibizumab Therapy for Central Retinal Vein Occlusion
condition: Treatment-naive cystoid macular edema secondary to central retinal vein occlusion, 23 eyes of 23 patients; multicenter open-label single-arm prospective study, Tsukuba University Hospital and Mito Kyodo General Hospital, 2016-2018; other ophthalmic disorders except mild refractive error and cataract excluded

groups.description: Whole cohort: three monthly injections, then PRN retreatment by OCT criteria; monthly examinations to 12 months

exclusions.what: Table 2 visual function rows (BCVA, LCS, metamorphopsia, aniseikonia, TST, TNO) and VFQ-25

exclusions.reason: Duplicate of the Table 2 baseline for the same eyes; Table 2 cited
Regression and correlation coefficients are not extracted

exclusions.what: Monthly examinations other than 3, 6 and 12 months
exclusions.reason: Not tabulated; no cells to cite

notes: Measure: CFT measured manually with the Cirrus analysis software on five-line raster cross-scans (not the automated 1-mm subfield mean): recorded as central_point; device cirrus.
Regimen loading_then_prn: three monthly ranibizumab injections, then additional injections when OCT/fluid retreatment criteria were met.
Role control: approved agent, single-arm cohort.
The number of injections is reported in the Results (not extracted).

series.notes: Mean +/- SD (Table 2 footnote); months after treatment; per-visit n not reported; no cataract surgery during the study period (Results)
